annotation.evidence_span: MAY change the request method from POST to GET
annotation.interpretation_a: A user agent is permitted to change a POST request to a GET request after receiving a 302 redirect.
annotation.interpretation_b: A user agent is not required to change a POST request to a GET request after receiving a 302 redirect; it can preserve the original method.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' grants discretion, but the lack of further constraints creates ambiguity about when this discretion is exercised. A concrete constraint specifying conditions for the method change would resolve the ambiguity.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify conditions under which the user agent *should* change the method, nor does it define any constraints on *when* it is permissible to do so. This leaves open the possibility of implementations that change the method arbitrarily, or not at all.
